description: This file contains internal data structures, type definitions, and function prototypes related to OpenSSL's EVP (Envelope) cryptographic API, including key management, encoding/decoding, and algorithm control functions.

classes.name: EVP_PKEY_ASN1_METHOD

classes.description: Structure defining method operations for public key algorithms.

classes.description: Context structure for public key operations, including method, key, and engine.

classes.description: Structure defining function pointers for key operation implementations.
